environment.description: Kubernetes deployment in 'iot-staging' namespace. Namespace has a default-deny egress NetworkPolicy applied at namespace level (metadata: name: restrict-egress-default, spec.podSelector: {}, policyTypes: [Egress], egress: []). A second NetworkPolicy 'allow-dns-only' permits UDP/53 to kube-dns. The LDAP server device-registry.internal resolves via CoreDNS but TCP connections to port 389 are blocked by the default-deny egress policy since no egress rule whitelists the LDAP CIDR (10.96.42.0/24). Pod has readOnlyRootFilesystem: true and drops all capabilities.
